sql_schemas: table employees | fields: id, first_name, last_name, email, manager_id, role, hire_date, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: manager_id -> employees.id | indexes: email: unique lookup for authentication and employee search; manager_id: listing direct reports for manager approval workflows; role: RBAC filtering at query level

table leave_types | fields: id, name, description, max_days_per_year, requires_approval, is_paid, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | indexes: name: unique lookup by leave type name (annual, sick, emergency)

table leave_requests | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type_id, start_date, end_date, total_days, reason, status, reviewer_id, reviewed_at, review_comment, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employees.id; leave_type_id -> leave_types.id; reviewer_id -> employees.id | indexes: employee_id: listing an employee's own leave requests; status: filtering by status for manager dashboards and pending-approval queues; reviewer_id: manager viewing requests awaiting their review; leave_type_id: filtering requests by leave type; start_date, end_date: date-range queries for overlapping leave detection and calendar views

table leave_balances | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type_id, year, total_allocated, used_days, pending_days, carried_over, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employees.id; leave_type_id -> leave_types.id | indexes: employee_id, leave_type_id, year: unique composite lookup for balance queries per employee per leave type per year; employee_id: fetching all balances for an employee; leave_type_id: aggregate balance queries across employees for a given leave type

table leave_policies | fields: id, leave_type_id, name, min_tenure_months, max_consecutive_days, requires_documentation, allow_carry_over, max_carry_over_days, notice_period_days, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: leave_type_id -> leave_types.id | indexes: leave_type_id: policy lookup by leave type; is_active: filtering active policies

table audit_logs | fields: id, entity_type, entity_id, action, changed_by, changes, created_at | pk: id | fks: changed_by -> employees.id | indexes: entity_type, entity_id: audit trail lookup for a specific entity; changed_by: audit trail lookup by user; action: filtering audit records by action type (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, REJECT); created_at: time-range audit queries
